disclaimer: Taxonomy entries describe illustrative regime shapes for replay ontology research — not forecasts, fragility scores, or trade signals.

archetypes.label: Retail participation-led attention surge
archetypes.dominant_structure: Market-native participation composites rise relative to contemporaneous acceleration/volatility in the replay window; external Reddit composites often track breadth and velocity.
archetypes.expected_convergence_behavior: Replay diagnostics tend to show Reddit composite / mention velocity gaps versus participation that shrink when curated snapshots imply coordinated retail chatter (alignment rises only when counts line up — observational).
archetypes.expected_participation_behavior: Relative volume and dollar-flow participation composites populate the upper half of their cross-sectional replay band more often than pure price-acceleration spikes in isolation.
archetypes.expected_narrative_behavior: Subreddit breadth and mention velocity lift together; headline density may lag unless wire volume rises in the same snapshot bundle.

archetypes.label: Thematic mass concentration
archetypes.dominant_structure: News thematic masses concentrate into few buckets (high narrative concentration / clustering); Reddit breadth may still be wide while semantic mass piles into dominant themes.
archetypes.expected_convergence_behavior: Narrative concentration and thematic clustering factors diverge from realized-volatility expansion when volatility is driven by microstructure noise rather than thematic shocks.
archetypes.expected_participation_behavior: Participation may sit mid-pack while thematic diagnostics spike — saturation reads as semantic crowding rather than pure flow breadth.
archetypes.expected_narrative_behavior: High thematic clustering with elevated headline density in curated snapshots; attention_share_concentration on raw thematic masses rises versus diffuse regimes.

archetypes.label: Co-expanded leverage reflexivity
archetypes.dominant_structure: Acceleration composites and realized volatility expansion move jointly at or above participation — coherent expansion path in Layer 2 factors.
archetypes.expected_convergence_behavior: Replay emission tag coherent_leverage_reflexivity marks batches where acceleration/volatility jointly dominate participation ordering.
archetypes.expected_participation_behavior: Participation remains supportive but may trail second derivatives — flows chase convex payoff zones rather than steady breadth accumulation.
archetypes.expected_narrative_behavior: External overlay may synchronize late if snapshots emphasize volatility-linked headlines rather than breadth-first chatter.

archetypes.label: Narrative ignition / synchronized saturation onset
archetypes.dominant_structure: Combined saturation index and external participation alignment lift together versus batch medians — curated counts imply Reddit/market stacks agreeing.
archetypes.expected_convergence_behavior: Small absolute gaps between Reddit attention composite and participation when snapshots imply ignition-class coordination.
archetypes.expected_participation_behavior: Participation climbs with thematic news mass in the same replay window rather than purely microstructure bursts.
archetypes.expected_narrative_behavior: Mention velocity and narrative concentration rise in tandem in external snapshots aligned to the replay window.

archetypes.label: Volatility clustering / RV expansion-led window
archetypes.dominant_structure: Realized volatility expansion leads the Layer 2 stack while participation and acceleration orderings shift around the shock window.
archetypes.expected_convergence_behavior: Thematic_clustering_minus_volatility gaps trend negative when volatility sits above narrative clustering in replay comparisons.
archetypes.expected_participation_behavior: Participation can mean-revert intrawindow while RV expansion remains sticky — descriptive ordering only.
archetypes.expected_narrative_behavior: Headline velocity may spike without proportional thematic clustering if desks churn tactical updates.
